name: bottle-block-carries-no-checksum
body: Eight of the nine Formula files carry a bottle block with root_url, rebuild and an arm64_sequoia sha256 that the release publish job's `brew bottle --merge --write` derives from the build JSON; Formula/apg-cobol.rb carries no bottle block, so until a tagged release merges one, `brew install antz29/apg/apg-cobol` builds from source. Limit: the repo gate checks formula syntax with `ruby -c` only, so a bottle block is validated by the macOS release run and not locally. Upgrade when the first tagged release after apg-cobol lands: confirm the merge wrote its bottle block, or add one by hand if the publish job skips a formula that has none.
